families: A: normalized exposure and recent programme activity
protocol.cohort_rule: Fixed original 4876 raw training-viewing users across every validation window, including users without recognized programmes; all 1260 template users separately. Snapshot training and feature generation may include additional users known before its cutoff.
protocol.selection: Nonnegative improvement over baseline in both disjoint backtests and original split; maximize mean MAP5 gain, otherwise retain baseline
protocol.calibration: Earlier out-of-time predictions, no validation or Kaggle labels
limitations: The original long holdout overlaps both short backtests
Relevance is the existing 80% broadcast-completion proxy, Kaggle definition unverified
Channel/hour/day profiles use clipped session start and watched seconds; programme stability uses a difference-of-airing-count proxy

selection.secondary_variant_criterion: Consistent gains on all 1260 template users in every window, while all-user MAP remains above old baseline; does not replace the primary all-user winner
selection.adaptive_deployment: Historically learned user-dependent calibrated blend; secondary template-cohort variant, not primary all-user winner

diagnosed_weaknesses_and_causal_limits.feature_ablation_support: Normalized exposure improves every chronological window; channel/time context improves the average further, with a tiny reduction versus A in the late window.
diagnosed_weaknesses_and_causal_limits.novelty_limit: Future schedule novelty is 33.8% versus 37.5% in main validation; increased future programme novelty is not supported as the cause.
diagnosed_weaknesses_and_causal_limits.relevance_limit: Changing historical completion threshold from 0.8 to 0.95 lowers baseline MAP5 from 0.502308 to 0.469414; this is sensitivity evidence, not identification of the unknown Kaggle relevance rule.
diagnosed_weaknesses_and_causal_limits.cohort_comparability: The reported 0.502308 offline score averages 4876 users; the original offline score on all 1260 submission users is 0.585273.
diagnosed_weaknesses_and_causal_limits.causal_limit: No hidden Kaggle labels are available; these diagnostics do not establish a unique cause of the Kaggle gap.
